# GitHub assets

Images in `assets/` for profile and repository.

## Profile avatar (`profile-avatar.png`)

- **Use:** GitHub account profile picture.
- **How:** [GitHub → Settings → Profile](https://github.com/settings/profile) → Profile picture → Upload `profile-avatar.png` (or your preferred crop).
- **Format:** Square; suitable for avatar (e.g. 512×512).

## Social preview (`social-preview.png`)

- **Use:** Image shown when the repo is shared (links, embeds).
- **How:** [Repo → Settings → General](https://github.com/iurii-izman/voiceforge/settings) → Social preview → Upload `social-preview.png`.
- **Recommended size:** 1280×640 px.

After uploading in Settings, these files in the repo serve as the source of truth and backup.
